svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Step 4 polish 04: the sound desk on a phone at 390 px
svg.text: 04 · The sound desk on a phone (390 px)
The same four sub-pages in one column; nothing wider than the phone. Book shot O30 (883 px wide, shrunk by the browser).

g.text: MP3 or OGG, at most 30 s and 1 MiB.
The zone has no sound screen

svg.text: The four sub-pages are a row of pills that scrolls sideways; the page itself never does. O30 was 883 px wide and shrunk to fit.
Master slider, Mute 15 min and Sound check head Cues and Library, the pages the crew opens on the floor.
Plain name, id and sounds below, preview and switch in the row. No table columns.
Category and effects wrap onto a second line instead of widening the page.
A player is the full width; Add a sound opens the library as a sheet.
The same controls as on the desktop, full width for the thumb.
Save and Cancel sit above the bottom bar (design decision 5).
Upload is one wide button; each sound is one card.
Each category is a card: level, interrupts, calm, on. The zone budget is one line per zone.
What happened and why first; time and zone below.
